title: City Directions
situation: Asking and giving directions in town
description: Essential phrases for finding places and understanding simple directions.

phrases.pt: Onde fica a farmácia mais próxima?
phrases.ipa: ˈõ.dʒi ˈfi.kɐ a faʁˈma.sjɐ majs ˈpɾɔ.si.mɐ

phrases.en: Turn right at the traffic light.

phrases.pt: Fica do outro lado da rua.
phrases.en: It’s on the other side of the street.
phrases.ipa: ˈfi.kɐ du ˈow.tɾu ˈla.du da ˈʁu.ɐ

phrases.pt: Passe pela praça e vire à esquerda.
phrases.en: Go past the square and turn left.
phrases.ipa: ˈpa.si ˈpe.lɐ ˈpɾa.sɐ i ˈvi.ɾi a esˈkeʁ.dɐ

phrases.pt: Você vai ver uma padaria na esquina.
phrases.en: You’ll see a bakery on the corner.
phrases.ipa: voˈse vaj veʁ ˈu.mɐ pa.daˈɾi.ɐ na esˈki.nɐ

phrases.en: The entrance is on the side.
